name: Azure DevOps REST API
tagline: Microsoft DevOps platform API for repos, pipelines, boards, artifacts, and work items
description: Microsoft’s Azure DevOps REST API provides programmatic access to Azure DevOps Services (cloud) and Azure DevOps Server (on-prem). Developers can manage Git repositories, CI/CD pipelines, work items, boards, test plans, artifacts, and organization settings. Authentication typically uses personal access tokens (PATs), OAuth 2.0, or Microsoft Entra ID. API versioning is query-parameter based (api-version).

auth.details: Personal Access Token (PAT) via HTTP Basic (username empty or arbitrary, password=PAT) or Bearer token; also OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID. Header: Authorization: Basic BASE64(:PAT) or Authorization: Bearer TOKEN

pricing.free_tier_limits: Azure DevOps Services free tier: first 5 users free; free Basic plan includes unlimited private Git repos, work item tracking, and 1,800 minutes of Microsoft-hosted CI/CD per month for open source / limited for private; API usage is not separately metered by request count in public docs — tied to Azure DevOps service plan
pricing.paid_plans: Basic plan ~$6/user/month after free users; Basic + Test Plans and other add-ons available; enterprise via Microsoft

rate_limits: not published as a simple global RPS; Azure DevOps enforces per-organization/resource throttling (HTTP 429) with Retry-After; exact numeric limits vary and are not fully published for all resources
use_cases: list Azure DevOps projects in an organization
create or update work items and query boards
trigger or inspect CI/CD pipeline runs
clone/list Git repositories and pull requests
download build artifacts or package feeds
